title: Queryfirst project configuration (queryfirst.json)
description: Lives at the project root. Every key is optional; unknown keys are an error (QF091). Connection strings are never stored here.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

include.description: Globs of query files, matched against project-relative paths with "/" separators. "*" does not cross "/"; "**" spans directories.

exclude.description: Globs of paths to skip (e.g. "sql-migration/**"). Replaces the default when given.

env.description: Environment variable holding the dev database connection string. When set, DATABASE_URL and PG* are not used. `qf generate --db` overrides it.

connection.description: Without it, the connection comes from DATABASE_URL, else the standard PG* variables.

pool.description: Connection pool size; describes run in parallel up to this many.

timestamp.description: How timestamp (without time zone) values are read (phase 2). When "utc", `qf test` checks that the database time zone is UTC (QF048); `qf bundle` carries it into the manifest.

env.description: Environment variable holding the target database connection string. Order: `--db`, this variable, DATABASE_URL / the PG* variables, then `command`.

command.description: Command run through the platform shell whose standard output is the connection string (tried last). The string is never printed or written.

emitTemplate.description: Output path; {{dir}} is the query file's project-relative directory, {{name}} its file name without extension.

typesOverrides.description: Postgres type name to TypeScript type, as in pgtyped: a type for both directions, or one per direction.

camelCaseColumnNames.description: Camel-case result column names in the generated types.

generators.description: The generators to run. Replaces the default (one TypeScript generator) when given; an empty list writes meta files only.
